title: Networking & Contacts
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El networking es clave en los negocios. Ahora sabes cómo hacer y mantener contactos en inglés.

parts.visual:
En un evento: 
- Introduce yourself (Presentarse). 
- Exchange business cards (Intercambiar tarjetas de presentación). 
- Make contacts (Hacer contactos). 
Ej: Let me introduce myself. I am John. Let's exchange business cards.
parts.audio: At an event. Introduce yourself. Exchange business cards. Make contacts. For example: Let me introduce myself. I am John. Let's exchange business cards.

parts.visual:
Manteniendo la relación: 
- Keep in touch (Mantenerse en contacto). 
- Reach out (Contactar / Escribir a alguien). 
- Follow up (Hacer seguimiento). 
Ej: It was nice meeting you. Let's keep in touch. I will reach out to you next week to follow up.
parts.audio: Maintaining the relationship. Keep in touch. Reach out means to contact someone. Follow up means to check on something again. For example: It was nice meeting you. Let's keep in touch. I will reach out to you next week to follow up.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la frase o palabra correcta de networking.

questions.question: Let me ____ myself. My name is Sarah. (Presentarme).
questions.explanation: Introduce oneself = presentarse. (En inglés, 'present' no se usa para presentarse a uno mismo).

questions.question: Can we exchange business ____? (Tarjetas de presentación).
It was very nice ____ you. (Conocerte - al despedirse).
questions.explanation: It was nice meeting you = Fue un placer conocerte.

questions.question: Let's keep in ____. (Mantengámonos en contacto).
questions.explanation: Keep in touch = mantenerse en contacto.

questions.question: I will ____ out to you next week on LinkedIn. (Contactarte / Escribirte).
questions.explanation: Reach out to someone = contactar, acercarse (escribir o llamar).

questions.question: I'm calling to ____ up on our meeting from yesterday. (Hacer seguimiento).
Are you on ____? Let's connect. (LinkedIn - la red profesional).
questions.explanation: LinkedIn es la red estándar para networking profesional.

questions.question: I'd like to ____ you to our Marketing Director, Mark. (Presentarte a...).
questions.explanation: Introduce someone to someone = presentar a alguien.

questions.question: We have a lot in ____. (En común).
questions.explanation: Have a lot in common = tener mucho en común.

questions.question: Here is my ____ information. (Información de contacto).
Events like this are great for ____. (Hacer networking).
What line of ____ are you in? (¿En qué rubro trabajas?).
questions.explanation: Line of work / Line of business = rubro, sector.

questions.question: Who do you ____ for? (¿Para quién trabajas?).
questions.explanation: Who do you work for? = ¿Para qué empresa trabajas?

questions.question: I look forward to ____ from you. (Saber de ti / Recibir noticias).
questions.explanation: Look forward to + verbo-ing = I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.question: Could you give me your ____ address? (Correo electrónico).
questions.explanation: Email address = dirección de correo electrónico.

questions.question: It's a small ____! (¡El mundo es un pañuelo! / ¡Qué pequeño es el mundo!).
questions.explanation: It's a small world = Expresión muy común en networking cuando descubres conexiones comunes.

questions.question: I'll ____ you an email later. (Enviaré/Escribiré - informal).
questions.explanation: Shoot an email = mandar un correo rápido.

questions.question: We should grab a ____ sometime. (Ir a tomar un café).
questions.explanation: Grab a coffee = ir por un café (muy común para reuniones informales de networking).

questions.question: Let's ____ up next week. (Reunirnos / Encontrarnos).
It's been great ____ to you. (Hablar contigo).
questions.explanation: It's been great talking to you = Ha sido genial hablar contigo.

questions.question: Let me ____ myself. (Presentarme con I)
Business ____. (Tarjetas de presentación)
Nice ____ you. (Conocerte)
Keep in ____. (Mantenerse en contacto)
I will ____ out to you. (Contactarte con R)
I need to ____ up. (Hacer seguimiento con F)
Let's ____ on LinkedIn. (Conectar)
We have a lot in ____. (En común)
Grab a ____. (Ir por un café)
What line of ____ are you in? (Trabajo/Rubro con W)
